verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a public REST API with JSON requests and responses. Downloadable OpenAPI specs cover both the FRAML and Management APIs, and there are official Python and Node/TypeScript clients, Postman support, and sandbox servers. The documented endpoints cover the core of the product: consumer and business users (including batch), transaction verification, rule templates and rule instances, cases and alerts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents drive the API successfully in practice, and evidence of authentication and rate-limit details.
